title: Impact of avian and arthropod predation on lepidopteran caterpillar densities and plant productivity in an ephemeral agroecosystem
authors: Hooks CRR, Pandey RR, Johnson MW
location: University of Hawaii Poamoho Research Station, Waialua, Oahu, Hawaii, U.S.A. (elevation 265 m)
design: Randomized assignment of 121 broccoli plants (44 assigned to 4 treatments, ~11 per treatment initially); 4 treatments: Bird (bird present, spiders removed daily), Bird+Spider (both present, no manipulation = ambient control), Spider (birds excluded by cage, spiders present), Check (birds and spiders both excluded). Sleeve cages excluded birds; daily spider removal by hand. Season: May-July 2002, 54-day experiment.
notes: n estimated from ANOVA df: F(3,26) for whole plant biomass → ~8 per treatment; F(3,24) for head weight → ~7 per treatment. Original assignment was ~11 plants per treatment from 44 total plants assigned; some mortality. Variance reported as SE throughout. Head weight SEs in Table 3 appear unrealistically small (0.01-0.02 g for heads weighing 112-182 g) — possibly a reporting error or the values may have been truncated. These are flagged but reported as printed. LSD used for post-hoc comparisons. Bird+Spider treatment (both birds and spiders present, no manipulation) is the natural/ambient predator control.

observations.treatment_description: Check — birds and spiders both excluded; plants enclosed in aluminium-framed cage with nylon bird netting and sleeve cage, spiders removed daily
observations.control_description: Bird + Spider — both birds and spiders present; no manipulation, plants accessible to all natural enemies

moderators.exclusion_level: full — both birds and spiders excluded

observations.notes: SE of 0.02 g for head weight of 112 g appears unrealistically small — likely a reporting error. Direction: exclusion reduces yield, consistent with expected biocontrol effect. Table 3 shows letter 'b' for Check vs 'ab' for Bird+Spider; ANOVA F(3,24)=3.7, P=0.03.

observations.treatment_description: Spider — birds excluded by aluminium-framed cage with nylon bird netting; spiders present
observations.control_description: Bird + Spider — both birds and spiders present, no manipulation
observations.notes: Spider treatment head weight (177.0 a) slightly higher than Bird+Spider (161.0 ab). Direction: bird exclusion does not reduce yield — opposite to expected. observations.control_description: Bird + Spider — both present, no manipulation
